title: Mileage Rate Setup
summary: Expense Agent now supports mileage rate configuration through new tables for vehicle types and mileage rates, with corresponding pages and APIs for managing these setup elements.
key_points: New Expense Vehicle Type and Mileage Rate Setup tables with list pages
New API pages for vehicle types and mileage rate setup; existing Expenses and Expense Report Lines APIs extended
Expense, Expense Report Line and Posted Expense Report Line tables and pages modified
Expense Capability enum and Expense Agent Setup page extended
Permission sets updated to cover the new objects, with new mileage tests
